description: A lo-fi drum voice that reads one of twenty-four short wavetables, with four ways of turning the reading into sound

params.text: Sets the decay of the voice within the band picked by the switch beside it
Picks one of three decay bands: up to 30ms, 30ms to 200ms, or 200ms to 4000ms
Picks which of the twenty-four wavetables the voice reads
Sets the rate the wavetable is read at
Sets the amount of the noise generator mixed into the reading
Swaps the voice between reading the wavetable straight through and folding it back on itself
Picks one of four ways the wavetable reading is turned into the output

inputs.text: A gate above 0.5V restarts the decay
Adds to the wavetable selection, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the read rate, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
Adds to the noise amount, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt
A gate above 0.5V swaps the reading mode whatever the switch beside it is set to

inputs.0: high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only
